purpose: Defines the fields, preconditions, and structure of the 'Contrast Safety Screening' screen within workflow WF_001.
postconditions: All required fields on 'Contrast Safety Screening' are captured and saved before advancing to the next screen.
validations: Confirm renal function value is on file and within an acceptable range before contrast administration
Confirm the allergy list has been reviewed for contrast-related allergies
Confirm any prior contrast reaction is flagged and visible before proceeding
common_errors: Contrast marked required with no renal function value on file
Prior reaction flag not surfaced to the technologist
